tools.name: get_live_activity
tools.summary: Newest events and entry ids only.

tools.name: get_agent_status
tools.summary: Return the BootUI Java agent's status: NOT_ATTACHED, DORMANT, ARMED, HELD by another application, DISARMED, UNAVAILABLE, FAILED, or DISABLED with a reason; versions, the current claim, sensors, and setup snippets that attach it.

tools.name: get_ai_overview
tools.summary: Return the local AI-framework telemetry overview derived from already-captured OTLP spans.

tools.name: get_architecture_report
tools.summary: Return the last completed Architecture advisor report without starting a new classpath scan.

tools.name: architecture_scan
tools.summary: Actively scan application classes for architecture and dependency violations.

tools.name: get_architecture_rule_violations
tools.summary: Read one page of retained violations for the exact rule id from get_architecture_report and that cached report's violationDetails.scanId.
tools.idHelp: A rule id and the violationDetails.scanId from 'bootui architecture report'.

tools.name: get_beans
tools.summary: Search Spring beans by name or type and return a bounded result.

tools.name: get_cache_stats
tools.summary: Return current cache manager and cache statistics (hits, misses, size) for each configured cache.

tools.name: get_code_inventory
tools.summary: Return Code Inventory: did the code changed since the previous run execute in this run? Advertised only while the BootUI agent's inventory sensor records this run (see get_agent_status).
tools.queryHelp: changed (the default), never-executed, not-tracked, executed, dependencies, or a package or class

tools.name: get_code_paths
tools.summary: Return Code Paths: which application bean methods each route spends its time in, from the BootUI agent's code-paths sensor.
tools.queryHelp: empty (the slowest routes), or a route or method name

tools.name: get_conditions
tools.summary: Search Spring auto-configuration condition evaluation outcomes by case-insensitive name and return matched, unmatched, and unconditional entries.

tools.name: get_config
tools.summary: Search effective configuration by name or displayed value and return a bounded result.

tools.name: get_crac_report
tools.summary: Return the last completed CRaC readiness report without starting a new resource-lifecycle scan.

tools.name: crac_scan
tools.summary: Actively assess Spring checkpoint/restore readiness.

tools.name: get_flyway_migrations
tools.summary: Return the current Flyway migration history and status without running migrate or clean.

tools.name: get_liquibase_changesets
tools.summary: Return the current Liquibase change-set history and status without running update.

tools.name: mysql_read
tools.summary: Actively read the application's MySQL JDBC datasources using bounded, read-only statistics queries.

tools.name: get_mysql_report
tools.summary: Return the last completed MySQL operational report without contacting the database.

tools.name: get_database_connection_pools
tools.summary: Return current connection pool configuration and live metrics (active, idle, pending connections) for each configured datasource.

tools.name: postgresql_read
tools.summary: Actively read PostgreSQL's own pg_stat_* and pg_catalog views for the application datasources and return what the server currently reports: the live session snapshot, cache hit and rollback ratios, connection usage, transaction-ID age, the top normalized statements, index and relation activity, autovacuum state, replication and notable settings.

tools.name: get_postgresql_report
tools.summary: Return the last completed PostgreSQL runtime view without querying the server again.

tools.name: get_database_advisor_report
tools.summary: Return the last completed Database advisor report without querying schema metadata again.

tools.name: database_advisor_scan
tools.summary: Actively introspect the physical database schema (tables, columns, keys, indexes) via read-only JDBC metadata, plus PostgreSQL/MySQL/MariaDB catalog checks and Hibernate mapping cross-reference when available.

tools.name: get_database_advisor_rule_violations
tools.summary: Read one page of retained violations for the exact rule id from get_database_advisor_report and that cached report's violationDetails.scanId.
tools.idHelp: A rule id and the violationDetails.scanId from 'bootui db report'.

tools.name: get_dev_services
tools.summary: Return the current local Dev Services or development-service inventory and masked connection metadata.

tools.name: trigger_devtools_livereload
tools.summary: Trigger the existing local Spring Boot DevTools LiveReload notification and return its action result.

tools.name: get_devtools_status
tools.summary: Return the current Spring Boot DevTools restart and LiveReload status.

tools.name: clear_exceptions
tools.summary: Clear BootUI's bounded in-memory exception groups and occurrences.

tools.name: get_exceptions
tools.summary: List recent exception groups, newest first.

tools.name: get_exception_detail
tools.summary: Return stack frames, causes, and occurrences for one exact exception-group id obtained from get_exceptions or get_live_activity.
tools.idHelp: An exception group id from 'bootui exceptions list' or 'bootui activity'.

tools.name: get_fault_tolerance
tools.summary: Return the configured Resilience4j and Spring Retry policy inventory with live counters and circuit breaker state, plus a bounded metadata-only event history.

tools.name: get_github_dashboard
tools.summary: Return local repository identity plus the last cached GitHub dashboard report.

tools.name: get_graalvm_report
tools.summary: Return the last completed GraalVM readiness report without starting a new classpath or dependency scan.

tools.name: graalvm_scan
tools.summary: Actively assess Spring native-image readiness without the longer dependency metadata scan.

tools.name: get_health
tools.summary: Return the current aggregated Actuator health tree.

tools.name: get_hibernate_report
tools.summary: Return the last completed Hibernate advisor report without starting a new mapping scan.

tools.name: hibernate_scan
tools.summary: Actively inspect JPA/Hibernate mappings and persistence configuration for correctness and performance risks.

tools.name: get_hibernate_rule_violations
tools.summary: Read one page of retained violations for the exact rule id from get_hibernate_report and that cached report's violationDetails.scanId.
tools.idHelp: A rule id and the violationDetails.scanId from 'bootui hibernate report'.

tools.name: get_http_exchanges
tools.summary: Return a bounded, newest-first snapshot of application HTTP request/response metadata.

tools.name: get_http_routes
tools.summary: Return route performance rankings over the retained HTTP exchanges: per method and route template, request and status-class counts, average, p50, p95, p99 and maximum duration, and share of request time, plus the evidence window.

tools.name: get_http_sessions
tools.summary: Return the bounded active embedded-Tomcat HTTP-session inventory without creating, clearing, or invalidating a session.

tools.name: get_runtime_run_comparison
tools.summary: Compare this run with a kept one: id is optional, previous or a run id.
tools.idHelp: Previous (the default), or a run id from the runs it answers with.

tools.name: get_runtime_impact
tools.summary: For a route, bean, class, method (Class#method, with parameter types for one overload), repository, table, cache, host, or event type id: the routes this run exercised through it, those it did not, and those sharing a resource with it, at most 8 each, or AMBIGUOUS with candidates.
tools.idHelp: A route, bean, class, Class#method, repository, table, cache, host, or event type.

tools.name: get_runtime_insights
tools.summary: Return what this run did that no single panel shows, compacted: coverage first, the checks that did not fully run, then at most limit (8) observations with an id, status, one sentence, counts, an exemplar request id for get_request_profile, a verify line, and whether the default list shows it.
tools.queryHelp: empty (the default list), all (every observation), new, security, diff, latency, an observation kind such as repeated-selects, or a route, table, bean, or class

tools.name: get_runtime_insight
tools.summary: Return one Runtime Insights observation by its id from get_runtime_insights, with every check to verify and at most 20 evidence rows.
tools.idHelp: An observation id from 'bootui insights list'.

tools.name: get_jms_activity
tools.summary: Return the bounded local JMS activity snapshot captured from application templates and listeners.

tools.name: get_jvm_tuning
tools.summary: Return the current JVM sizing facts and generated tuning recommendations using detected defaults.

tools.name: get_kafka_activity
tools.summary: Return the bounded local Kafka activity snapshot captured from application producers and consumers.

tools.name: get_loggers
tools.summary: Search configured loggers by case-insensitive name and return their configured and effective levels, bounded by limit.

tools.name: get_log_tail
tools.summary: Return the latest buffered application log snapshot.

tools.name: get_emails
tools.summary: Return the bounded local email-capture inventory with content governed by BootUI exposure policy.

tools.name: get_mappings
tools.summary: Search request routes and handlers and return a bounded result.

tools.name: analyze_heap_dump
tools.summary: Analyze the existing BootUI heap dump and return the resulting report.

tools.name: get_heap_dump_report
tools.summary: Return passive heap-dump status, file metadata, and any already-cached analysis.

tools.name: get_live_memory
tools.summary: Return a passive snapshot of current JVM heap, non-heap, garbage collection, class-loading, and thread measurements without requesting GC or a class histogram.

tools.name: get_memory_report
tools.summary: Return the last completed Memory advisor report without triggering a class histogram or full GC.

tools.name: memory_scan
tools.summary: Actively analyze JVM memory and return prioritized findings.

tools.name: get_memory_rule_violations
tools.summary: Read one page of retained violations for the exact rule id from get_memory_report and that cached report's violationDetails.scanId.
tools.idHelp: A rule id and the violationDetails.scanId from 'bootui memory report'.

tools.name: get_metrics
tools.summary: Search the current application metrics inventory and return a bounded page of local meter values.

tools.name: get_overview
tools.summary: Return stable application identity and runtime context, including versions, active profiles, and BootUI status.

tools.name: get_pentest_report
tools.summary: Return the last completed Pentesting advisor report without sending any HTTP probes.

tools.name: pentest_scan
tools.summary: Actively send bounded synthetic probes to this application's loopback endpoint and return security findings.

tools.name: get_method_probe
tools.summary: Return a method probe by the id start_method_probe returned: its state (starting, active, ending, ended, failed), why it ended or failed, and each recorded invocation's duration, thread kind, request id, outcome or exception type, and calling frame.
tools.idHelp: A probe id from 'bootui probe start'.

tools.name: start_method_probe
tools.summary: Start a method probe: an action that retransforms one application method of the running application to record its next 20 invocations, for at most 60 seconds (five probes at once), then removes itself; it ends with the run.
tools.idHelp: An application method (binary.Class#name) from 'bootui code paths'.

tools.name: get_profile_diff
tools.summary: Return the current active-profile configuration comparison using masked local configuration data.

tools.name: get_rabbitmq_activity
tools.summary: Return the bounded local RabbitMQ activity snapshot captured from application publishers and listeners.

tools.name: get_spring_data_repositories
tools.summary: Return Spring Data repository metadata already computed by the application context.

tools.name: get_request_profile
tools.summary: Open a profileable request or scheduled/message execution id from get_live_activity or a get_runtime_insights exemplar.
tools.idHelp: A profileable request or execution id (an entry id or an observation's exemplarRequestId) from 'bootui activity' or 'bootui insights list'.

tools.name: get_rest_api_report
tools.summary: Return the last completed REST API advisor report without starting a new endpoint scan.

tools.name: rest_api_scan
tools.summary: Actively inspect Spring REST controllers and API design for correctness and maintainability risks.

tools.name: get_rest_api_rule_violations
tools.summary: Read one page of retained violations for the exact rule id from get_rest_api_report and that cached report's violationDetails.scanId.
tools.idHelp: A rule id and the violationDetails.scanId from 'bootui rest-api report'.

tools.name: clear_rest_client_traces
tools.summary: Clear the bounded in-memory REST-client trace buffer and return the resulting report.

tools.name: pause_rest_client_recording
tools.summary: Pause REST-client trace recording and return the resulting report.

tools.name: resume_rest_client_recording
tools.summary: Resume REST-client trace recording and return the resulting report.

tools.name: get_rest_client_traces
tools.summary: Return the current bounded REST-client trace snapshot with masked headers and bodies according to BootUI exposure policy.

tools.name: get_scheduled_tasks
tools.summary: Return the current scheduled task inventory and recent run history, including timing and outcome.

tools.name: get_spring_security
tools.summary: Return the current Spring Security filter-chain and authentication configuration report.

tools.name: get_security_logs
tools.summary: Return a bounded, newest-first snapshot of authentication and authorization audit events.

tools.name: get_security_report
tools.summary: Return the last completed Security advisor report without starting a new configuration scan.

tools.name: security_scan
tools.summary: Actively review application security configuration and return prioritized findings.

tools.name: get_security_rule_violations
tools.summary: Read one page of retained violations for the exact rule id from get_security_report and that cached report's violationDetails.scanId.
tools.idHelp: A rule id and the violationDetails.scanId from 'bootui security report'.

tools.name: get_claude_code_sessions
tools.summary: Return the bounded, sanitized Claude Code session inventory already parsed from local session files.

tools.name: get_copilot_sessions
tools.summary: Return the bounded, sanitized Copilot CLI session inventory already parsed from local session files.

tools.name: get_side_effects
tools.summary: Return Side Effects: what the application does outside the JVM, from the BootUI agent's side-effect sensors; this version records the processes it starts, its network: connects, datagram sends, and host names the JVM resolved, the blocking calls (sleep, wait, park, a blocking network or file operation) started on an event loop, and, opt-in, the files it opens, deletes, moves, and copies, the environment variables and system properties it reads, and request input reaching a sink (security-sinks, request-input-in-sink).

tools.name: get_spring_report
tools.summary: Return the last completed Spring advisor report without starting a new application scan.

tools.name: spring_scan
tools.summary: Actively inspect Spring configuration and bean usage for correctness and maintainability risks.

tools.name: get_spring_rule_violations
tools.summary: Read one page of retained violations for the exact rule id from get_spring_report and that cached report's violationDetails.scanId.
tools.idHelp: A rule id and the violationDetails.scanId from 'bootui spring report'.

tools.name: clear_sql_traces
tools.summary: Clear the bounded in-memory SQL trace buffer and return the resulting report.

tools.name: pause_sql_trace_recording
tools.summary: Pause SQL trace recording and return the resulting report.

tools.name: resume_sql_trace_recording
tools.summary: Resume SQL trace recording and return the resulting report.

tools.name: get_sql_traces
tools.summary: Return the current bounded SQL trace snapshot with statements and timings.

tools.name: get_startup_timeline
tools.summary: Return the captured Spring startup-step timeline after filtering BootUI's own steps.

tools.name: get_threads
tools.summary: Search the current JVM thread snapshot and return a bounded page of thread states and stack summaries.

tools.name: clear_traces
tools.summary: Clear BootUI's bounded in-memory trace buffer.

tools.name: get_traces
tools.summary: Return a bounded, newest-first snapshot of distributed and local traces captured by BootUI.

tools.name: clear_transactions
tools.summary: Clear the bounded in-memory Spring transaction trace buffer and return the resulting report.

tools.name: get_transactions
tools.summary: Return the current bounded transaction-boundary snapshot with outcomes, timings, nesting, and correlated SQL counts.

tools.name: pause_transaction_recording
tools.summary: Pause Spring transaction-boundary recording and return the resulting report.

tools.name: resume_transaction_recording
tools.summary: Resume Spring transaction-boundary recording and return the resulting report.

tools.name: get_vulnerabilities_report
tools.summary: Return the cached vulnerability report, or the local dependency inventory before the first scan, without contacting OSV.dev or any other network service.

tools.name: vulnerabilities_scan
tools.summary: Actively query OSV.dev for known vulnerabilities in this application's dependencies and return severity-ranked findings.
